The '''Chestrashus system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chestrashi]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Galladinium" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chestrashus system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-3.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
